h: Shabbos and Shemittah Join Divine Gift With Human Effort

p: וְשָׁבְתָה הָאָרֶץ שַׁבָּת וְגוֹ׳ (וַיִּקְרָא כה, ב)
'And the land shall rest a Shabbos, etc.' (Vayikra 25:2).
set upon sockets of fine gold';
as is written (in the passage Pasach Eliyahu):
they are called the supports of the Torah;
and Netzach and Hod are the supports,
for Moshe is the groomsman of the King
and Aharon the groomsman of the Matronisa
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זוֹהַר חֵלֶק ג נג, ב)
And this is the matter of capital and base:
for the base is the foundation,
on which the whole building is built
and it is the holiness of Shabbos,
and this is the aspect of Moshe,
only from the side of Hashem Yisbarach,
"to know that I am Hashem Who sanctifies you,"
in My treasure house, and Shabbos is its name,
and I wish to give it to Yisrael";
in the gift of his portion."
And the capital is the holiness of Shemittah,
and it is the aspect of Aharon,
for this is principally from the side of man,
as they said in the Midrash Rabbah
גִּבּוֹרֵי כֹחַ עוֹשֵׂי דְבָרוֹ (תְּהִלִּים קג, כ)
"'Mighty in strength who do His word' (Tehillim 103:20):
of whom does the pasuk speak? etc.
Of those who keep Shemittah, etc.:
he sees his field lying fallow,
and pays the tax and is silent;
יֵשׁ לְךָ גִּבּוֹר גָּדוֹל מִזֶּה וְכוּלֵּי
is there a greater hero than this? etc."
and this is from the side of man,
"What does Hashem your God ask of you
and "Everything is in the hands of Heaven
And it is the aspect of a capital,
and tied to each one of Yisrael
as it says, 'Mighty in strength who do His word,'
and then 'to hearken to the voice of His word.'"
which he expounded as "mighty in strength":
therefore it is the aspect of a capital,
it is the crown of "we will do and we will hear,"
for although it is from the side of man,
אַף עַל פִּי כֵן הִיא גַּם כֵּן
from above, from the side of Hashem Yisbarach,
"Were it not that the Holy One, blessed is He, helps him,
to be among the "mighty in strength."
And likewise Shabbos, which is the base,
for although the entire essence of the holiness of Shabbos
is from the side of the Holy One, blessed is He,
אַף עַל פִּי כֵן צָרִיךְ הָאָדָם מִצִּדּוֹ
even so a person must on his part
and make preparation for the holiness of Shabbos;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים רַבָּה ה, ב)
"Open for Me like the opening of a needle,
and I will open for you, etc.";
וְזֶהוּ אֶת שַׁבְּתוֹתַי תִּשְׁמוֹרוּ (וַיִּקְרָא כו, ב)
And this is "My Shabbosos you shall keep" (Vayikra 26:2):
the keeping is from the side of man;
which is the aspect of the Mikdash,
from the side of Hashem Yisbarach;
which is the aspect of supernal fear;
כִּי הַרְבֵּה מַדְרֵגוֹת יֵשׁ בְּמִדָּה זוֹ
for there are many levels in this attribute,
"May it be that there be upon you
fear of Heaven like the fear of flesh and blood.
They said to him: And no more? etc."
And so on, up to the highest.
And this is "And My Sanctuary you shall revere":
which is the aspect of the Mikdash,
